title: Priority Reservation Handoff and Stakeholder Transparency Protocol
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Design and deliver a lightweight protocol that lets PMs reserve sprint capacity for top-account escalations with formal handoff steps and a transparency dashboard for stakeholders. The protocol will combine a small escrowed capacity pool, an impact-driven reservation process, and automated notifications to reduce ad-hoc scope shifts and make trade-offs auditable.
background: High-touch enterprise customers are repeatedly asking for priority lanes; engineering and GTM report frequent last-minute scope shifts that cause sprint churn. Existing intake flows are informal and lack a single auditable handoff that documents commitment, acceptance criteria, rollback windows, and cost to other roadmap items.
proposal: Create a Priority Reservation Handoff (PRH) workflow: 1) small sprint escrow pool (2 story points / squad per cycle) allocated to PMs for emergent top-account needs; 2) reservation request form capturing customer ask, SLO impact, estimated points, acceptable rollback date, and stakeholder sign-offs; 3) automated creation of a tracked Linear sub-issue with labeled metadata; 4) a public dashboard in Console PRD space showing active reservations, status, and impact score; 5) weekly review cadence and a one-click release/rollback action for engineering leads.
tradeoffs: Escrow reduces visible sprint capacity and may slow feature velocity for non-top-account roadmap items
Automating reservations adds implementation overhead (dashboard + Linear hooks) but reduces ad-hoc Slack/meeting overhead
Tightening sign-off may delay urgent fixes; we need a fast-path for severity P0 incidents
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): Build reservation form, Linear webhooks to auto-create PRH tickets, add labels and metadata mapping
Phase 2 (3 sprints): Implement Console dashboard mock + read-only API to surface reservations; create notification templates for stakeholders and engineering leads
Phase 3 (1 sprint): Add one-click release/rollback control for squad leads; document runbook and train PMs and ENG leads
Phase 4 (ongoing): Iterate on impact scoring thresholds and adjust escrow size based on usage metrics
milestones: 2026-02-15: Reservation form spec and sign-off (PRD link)

2026-03-29: Runbook published and PM/ENG training session
acceptance_criteria: Reservation form auto-creates a Linear ticket with required metadata (customer, impact score, points, rollback date)
Console dashboard shows all active reservations with filter by account, status, and cycle
Engineering leads can accept or reject a reservation within 24 hours and trigger a one-click release/rollback
Usage telemetry exists: number of reservations, avg points reserved, percent executed vs rolled back
Stakeholder transparency: Sales/Customer Success can view reservation status and timeline via shared link
